neighbours.label: the repeated word in a parallel formula (another day, another ...; one nation, one ...; which X for which Y)
fire: The press called it another week, another scandal at city hall.
Their slogan was simple: one team, one dream, one goal.
The guide explains which tent for which season you should buy.
For the commuters it was another morning, another delayed train.
The rally chanted one people, one voice until the speech began.
It was another year, another record for the small bakery downtown.
The chart shows which fertilizer for which crop works best.
She smiled and said: another city, another hotel room, another show.
